title: Complete payment processing outage
user_facing_impact: All payment transactions failed with 'payment declined' error. Users unable to complete purchases.
root_cause: Untested configuration change to payment-service rate limiter pushed directly to production. New config set max_concurrent_requests to 5 (from 500), causing immediate request rejection for 99% of traffic.
contributing_factors: No automated config validation for rate limiter bounds
Change was pushed during peak traffic hours (09:00 UTC)
Morning traffic spike (normal) masked initial error signals for 3 minutes

timeline.event: Error rate spikes to 99.2%. Alerts fire.
Initial diagnosis: suspected DDoS due to traffic spike coincidence
DDoS ruled out. Investigation shifts to recent changes.
Root cause identified: rate limiter config change

resolution: Rolled back the config change. Added validation rule preventing max_concurrent_requests < 100.
action_items: Add config validation bounds for all rate limiter parameters
Require staging deployment for config changes
Add automated rollback trigger when error rate exceeds 50% within 2 minutes
external_factor_detail: Normal morning traffic ramp coincided with the incident window; detection lagged by ~3 minutes.
